headline: South Korea ditches 'denuclearization-first' strategy. What will Pyongyang do next?
context: South Korea is moving away from its policy of prioritizing the immediate denuclearization of North Korea. But despite that shift, experts doubt Pyongyang will return to the negotiating table.
